purpose: This table is the cleaned OurAirports airports reference feeding downstream analytics and lookups that join on a stable airport identifier; it covers every airport in the source extract that carries an IATA code, with one row per airport.
usage: Join on id, the declared grain key, which is unique and non-null across all 9057 rows; treat NA in continent and iso_country as the valid codes for North America and Namibia rather than missing data, and expect nulls in elevation_ft, municipality, icao_code, gps_code, local_code, home_link, wikipedia_link, and keywords to represent genuinely unpublished values that consumers must handle explicitly rather than assume are errors.
limitations: Cleanup did not resolve the high sparsity in local_code (63.66% null), home_link (74.90% null), and keywords (67.96% null); these columns are retained as-is without imputation. Latitude and longitude were narrowed from DECIMAL(38,9) to DECIMAL(9,6) based on observed sample precision, which could truncate any higher-precision values not present in the sampled rows, and the type column's enum was not constrained to the full OurAirports vocabulary because only 5 of the documented values appeared in this profile.
